d:
Supreme Court Tuesday issued notice on a petition filed by legacy media houses against The Digital Personal Data Protection Act. The plea raises a crucial question—whether journalists can report freely and independently if they need consent from the person against whom they report. The law requires media houses to comply with stringent obligations, just like any other data handler. Bhadra Sinha explains why media houses have challenged the law and their concern over a possible regime of pre-censorship.
